facts: Ground reaction force is the equal and opposite reaction to the force you apply into the ground.
Most human joints act as third-class levers, optimizing speed and range of motion.
Torque is the rotational effect of a force applied at a distance from a joint axis.
A stable trunk helps transfer force between the lower and upper body efficiently.
Hip mobility without control can increase compensation during loaded movement.
Bracing increases intra-abdominal pressure and can improve spinal stability under load.
Knee valgus can be influenced by foot mechanics, hip control, and trunk position.
Power equals force multiplied by velocity; intent can change recruitment patterns.
